items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: Dizzy flew especially for the session and flew right back after the session.

ctx.x: No I think one of two records. Either I take one or the other. Because I’m trying to think of all the records that’s got in itself everything I like. I will take the “Trumpet Summit Meets Oscar Peterson Big Four.” That’s a session that was done in one night in Hollywood. Dizzy flew especially for the session and flew right back after the session.
